body:
This PR updates UnrolledUtilities.jl to v0.1.11, making several simplifications in the process:
- Drop the `Unrolled` module from `Utilities` (it was ported in CliMA/UnrolledUtilities.jl#36), and clean up the deprecated names (`unrolled_map_with_inbounds` and `unrolled_tuple_map`)
- Drop all `values(::NamedTuple)` shims
- Drop all `keyword argument -> positional argument` shims
- Drop the `unrolled_filter -> unrolled_flatmap` shim, and some other similar ones related to `sum`/`maximum`
- Clean up the scattered `import UnrolledUtilities: ...` statements
